request: Let's make this part symmetric. There is a step on one of the sides of the whistle. Move the protruding surface so that it is level with the surface next to it. Delete all chamfers and radii and new ones following rules: Horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger part of the whistle meet have a radius R=20mm. Other edges have R=5mm applied to them

actions.operation: Move the protruding surface until it is coplanar with the adjacent surface.
actions.target: The protruding surface associated with the step on one side of the whistle.
actions.relational_constraint: The moved surface must be level with the surface next to it.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the one-sided step, its protruding surface, and the adjacent surface that defines the required level.

actions.relational_constraint: Removal applies to every existing chamfer.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify all chamfer features or chamfered edge geometry in the CAD model.

actions.target: All existing radiused or filleted edges on the part.
actions.relational_constraint: Removal applies to every existing radius before new radii are created.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify all radius or fillet features and their affected edges in the CAD model.

actions.operation: Apply edge radii to the horizontal edges in the transition area.
actions.target: Horizontal edges in the area where the narrow and bigger parts of the whistle meet.
actions.relational_constraint: The edges must be horizontal and located at the meeting area between the narrow and bigger portions.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the narrow portion, the bigger portion, their meeting area, and which edges in that area are horizontal.

actions.operation: Apply edge radii to all remaining edges.
actions.target: All other edges not assigned the 20 mm radius.
actions.relational_constraint: Use 5 mm on the complement of the horizontal transition-edge set receiving the 20 mm radius.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify all remaining edges after resolving the edges that receive the 20 mm radius.

intention: Make the whistle part symmetric by eliminating the one-sided step.
Replace the existing edge treatments with a consistent radius scheme based on edge location.
